Add Features.description: Adds point features to a hosted feature layer, e.g. geotagged survey submissions or new facilities.

Update Features.description: Updates attributes of existing features (matched by OBJECTID), e.g. a facility's stock or service status.

Delete Features.description: Deletes features from a layer by OBJECTID or a where clause.

Query Features.description: Queries a feature layer with a where clause, e.g. to pull health facilities for one district.

Geocode Address.description: Turns an address or place name into coordinates with the ArcGIS World Geocoding Service.

Generate Token.description: Exchanges ArcGIS username/password for a short-lived access token to use in later requests.
